releases.notes:
# Changelog

## 1.0.0 Initial Release

First public release of ForceRender.

### Added
- Force-render armor stands and item frames within a configurable distance
- Master enable/disable toggle
- Configurable render distance (1–64 blocks, default 5)
- Per-entity-type toggles for armor stands and item frames (normal + glow)
- Mod Menu config screen via Cloth Config API
- Config saved to `.minecraft/config/forcerender.json`
